inputs.text: As part of her 2026 State of the State agenda, she’s proposing that guns sold in New York be designed so they can’t be easily modified into illegal machine guns. That puts some responsibility on the industry to prevent foreseeable misuse, rather than leaving communities to bear the consequences. The proposal would also establish criminal penalties, though the account doesn’t specify who they would apply to.

output.main_topic: Proposal to require guns sold in New York to resist modification into illegal machine guns
subtopics: Industry responsibility for preventing foreseeable misuse
